CALL TO ORDER

At 4:01 PM, Chair Ramirez called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Lewis, Minjarez, Sides, Melgarejo, Ramirez

  Commissioners Absent: Chambers, Esparza

Also present: Christopher Koontz, President, Meggan Sorensen, Vice President, Margaret Madden,
Neighborhood Improvement Officer, Adam Jacobs, Deputy City Attorney, Alyssa Campos, City Clerk
Specialist, Rosa Garibay, City Clerk Assistant.

Director Chambers and Director Esparza are excused from the meeting.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Vice Chair Melgarejo led the Pledge of Allegiance.

  A motion was made by Director Minjarez, seconded by Vice Chair Melgarejo,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None

  Christopher Koontz, President, spoke.
